weeks.title: Week 1: Basic EPS
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 1: Basic EPS

Learning Objectives

  • Calculate basic EPS numerator (income available to common)
  • Compute weighted-average common shares outstanding
  • Adjust for stock splits and stock dividends retroactively

Key Topics

1. Numerator (NI - preferred dividends)

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Numerator (NI - preferred dividends). Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Numerator (NI - preferred dividends) concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Numerator (NI - preferred dividends) is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

2. Denominator (weighted-average shares)

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Denominator (weighted-average shares) concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Denominator (weighted-average shares) is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

CPA Exam Tip: Stock splits and dividends is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

Practice Application

Work through practice problems applying week 1: basic eps concepts. These problems mirror actual CPA exam scenarios and real-world CFO challenges.

Key Takeaways

  • Master Numerator (NI - preferred dividends) for exam success and professional competence

  • Master Stock splits and dividends for exam success and professional competence
  • Understand authoritative guidance and when to apply it
  • Practice computational problems until you can solve them efficiently
  • Connect concepts to real-world CFO responsibilities

weeks.title: Week 2: Diluted EPS - Stock Options & Warrants
weeks.lessonHtml:

weeks.title: Week 3: Diluted EPS - Convertible Securities
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 3: Diluted EPS - Convertible Securities

weeks.title: Week 4: Complex EPS Scenarios
weeks.lessonHtml:
